description:
This is a notice of intent to proceed with a sole source requirement simplified procedures.Â  The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Veterans Health Administration (VHA), National Center for PTSD (NCPTSD) has a requirement for a contractor to plan, coordinate, provide support for, and help deliver trainings for non-VA providers who treat Veterans on the topics of Military Culture, Assessment of PTSD, and Assessment and Management of Suicide Risk.

This notice is NOT a request for competitive proposals. Any vendor who wishes to submit information for this requirement should email their information to the attention of Nicole Lowther at nicole.lowther@va.gov by 1300 May 14, 2026. Only email submissions will be accepted.

See attachment for additional information.
